cards.subject: The Oracle's caverns
lines: Warcraft III put the hinge of the Third War under this peak: Thrall and Cairne climbing down through statues and traps, Jaina already waiting, and the Oracle turning out to be Medivh.
There is no trace of it in this game. No cave, no chamber, nothing.

cards.subject: Talondeep Path
lines: The main northern connection to Ashenvale is a cave system.
You do not walk over this border. You go through the mountain and come out in a clear-cut.

cards.subject: Windshear Crag
lines: This valley was old-growth forest at the scale of the trees still standing in Ashenvale next door.
Vanilla shows you the aftermath instead of telling you about it: stumps, oily water, gyrocopter pads, machinery running with nobody attending it.
Kobolds mine underneath while the goblins strip the top.

cards.subject: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle
lines: He is a leper gnome — one of the Gnomeregan irradiated.
A gnome giving orders to goblins, in a zone about industry eating a forest.

cards.subject: The Super Reaper 6000
lines: Gerenzo designed it here for the Venture Company. Sputtervalve, pushed out of the operation, hired Ziz Fizziks to steal the plans.
Then he started building them for the Horde.
Every shredder anywhere in the world traces back to a theft in this crag.

cards.subject: Sishir Canyon
lines: Wall to wall Deepmoss spiders, their eggs and their webbing, with Besseleth the largest of them.
Cataclysm opened the canyon out and put the name Sishir on a different, newer canyon further west.
The Sishir on this map and the Sishir on a modern one are not the same place.

cards.subject: The floating tree
lines: The bug fix reads, verbatim: "No longer a tree floating off the ground in the Sishir Canyon area."
For the game's first four months there was a tree hanging in mid-air down there.

cards.subject: Rynthariel the Keymaster
lines: She is a dryad, not a night elf, and her job is keeping the Den's magical caches shut.
She is said to have hidden her key in a small lantern at the entrance.

cards.subject: The coast you cannot walk to
cards.tag: Watch left on the flight path
lines: West of the zone is a strip that is on the map and unreachable on foot: an abandoned Venture Co. camp with cranes and a shredder on a walkway, night elf ruins, a troll hut.
And a crashed airplane on a clifftop, with helipads and parked aircraft beside it.
Built purely as scenery for the gryphons passing over.

cards.subject: Sun Rock Retreat
lines: It is not just an outpost. Tauren made pilgrimages here to cross into the spirit world.
The story is that the sun himself kissed the rock the retreat stands on, and the early settlers carried flaming totems to the highest peaks to honour him.
The Charred Vale is the joke this zone plays on that.

cards.subject: Who burned the Charred Vale
lines: Keeper Albagorm at Stonetalon Peak: "The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists."
Not dragons. Not a volcano. Goblins with machines.
It is the same crime as the stumps at Windshear — one zone, two halves.

cards.subject: No dragons, no lava
cards.tag: What is actually in the vale
lines: Bloodfury harpies, blackened ancients, chimaera matriarchs, scorched basilisks.
The black dragons and the erupting volcano all arrive with Cataclysm.
The vale you are standing in is burnt, not burning — a dead grey forest.

cards.subject: Why it was buried
lines: The wiki's own note on why Cataclysm poured lava over it: the vale was hated in vanilla for low drop rates in a very mob-dense area, so the developers destroyed it.
You are standing in a place that was erased because people complained about it.
